info.title: PLRD Forum API
info.summary: Read and write endpoints for PLRD Forum, a LessWrong-style ATProto forum.
info.description: PLRD Forum stores all content as records in users' ATProto data repositories (site.standard.* lexicons). Read endpoints are public; writes require an ATProto OAuth session and create records in the signed-in user's own PDS. Pages also support markdown content negotiation via Accept: text/markdown, and an MCP server is published at /.well-known/mcp with tools get_frontpage, get_post, and list_concepts.

get.summary: Markdown variant of any site page
get.description: Equivalent to requesting a page with Accept: text/markdown. Returns text/markdown; responses carry Vary: Accept.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Site path to render as markdown, e.g. /, /allPosts, /posts/<did>/<rkey>.

post.summary: Index an actor's ATProto records into the local index

200.description: Posts ranked by recency with karma and comment counts

post.description: Writes a site.standard.document record to the signed-in user's PDS; auto-creates their publication on first post.
Writes a site.standard.graph.recommend record to the user's PDS. Karma equals the number of recommends.
Writes a site.standard.graph.subscription record to the user's PDS.
Model Context Protocol endpoint exposing read-only tools: get_frontpage, get_post, list_concepts. Send JSON-RPC 2.0 requests (initialize, tools/list, tools/call).

securitySchemesNote: Writes use ATProto OAuth (authorization_code + PKCE); no API keys are issued.
